summary: A self-contained, accessible space exploration quiz in one index.html file.

services.name: Frontend
services.description: A standalone browser-based quiz with no server or external dependencies.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: A single self-contained HTML file can implement the quiz with embedded CSS and JavaScript.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use plain JavaScript with HTML and CSS in one file.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Use TypeScript and a compile step.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: The requested quiz is a single self-contained HTML file with no dependencies.

options.label: No framework
options.description: Use browser-native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

options.label: React
options.description: Use React for a component-based frontend.

options.label: Vue
options.description: Use Vue for a component-based frontend.

questions.question: What frontend features are required?
questions.recommendedChoice: 10-question colorful, accessible space exploration quiz with progress bar, score counter, animated correct/incorrect feedback, results screen, and restart; all in index.html with no server or dependencies.
questions.answer: 10-question colorful, accessible space exploration quiz with progress bar, score counter, animated correct/incorrect feedback, results screen, and restart; all in index.html with no server or dependencies.

questions.question: Which data stores are required?
questions.rationale: The quiz runs locally in the browser and does not require persistence.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The application does not need persistent storage.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: The quiz is a standalone browser experience without sign-in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users must sign in to use application features.

options.label: No
options.description: The application is available without sign-in.
